title: Israeli Forces Storm Wedding Hall in Al-Eizariya, Arrest Groom
detail: Israeli forces stormed a wedding hall in the West Bank town of al-Eizariya, near Jerusalem, on Saturday, August 15, 2026, according to the Palestinian news agency WAFA. Video circulated online shows the raid unfolding as music continued to play inside the hall. Troops reportedly opened fire, launched sound bombs, and used pepper spray on attendees before assaulting and arresting several guests, including the groom. The incident was one of several Israeli incursions into West Bank communities that day.

media.caption: Israeli forces raid a wedding hall in al-Eizariya, occupied West Bank, arresting the groom among several attendees — August 15, 2026
